data.description: Deferred from PQ-76 (PR #95, merged at fe092af; the delegator's deviation 3). `just migrate-club --write` (pipeline/src/popquiz/schedule.py, migrate-club; default backup_dir is <bank>/backups/club-rename-<UTC time>/, around line 700) copies each record it changes into bank/backups/ before replacing it. .gitignore on main has no rule for bank/backups/, so a real migration leaves an untracked folder that `git add bank` would sweep into a commit; docs/RUNBOOK.md 'Releasing the club rename' step 3 only says to leave it out of the commit. Decide: add bank/backups/ to .gitignore, or move the default backup_dir outside the repo (and update the RUNBOOK and the --backup-dir help to match). Re-find line numbers first. Acceptance: after a --write run that changes a record, git status shows no bank/backups/ entry (or the default lands outside the repo); the migrate-club tests stay green under just test; no change to the bank's records, the alias tables, or any visible copy.
data.title: The club migration's backups land in bank/backups/, which git does not ignore
